prompts.spam_detection:
Analyze this GitHub Issue/PR for spam content:

Title: {title}
Body: {body}
Template: {template_analysis}
{file_changes}

Is this spam or meaningless content?
Spam indicators:
- Random characters or keyboard mashing (e.g., 'asdfghjkl', 'qwerty123')
- Advertisement or promotional content
- Malicious links or content
- Completely unrelated to the project
- Obvious test submissions with no purpose
- Repeated identical content
- Content in languages completely unrelated to project context

Note: For Issues, file_changes will be empty. For PRs, it shows actual code changes.

Respond ONLY with:
- `SPAM` - if spam or meaningless content
- `NOT_SPAM` - if legitimate content (even if low quality)
prompts.readme_coverage_check:
Check if this GitHub Issue is EXPLICITLY and COMPLETELY covered in the README or pinned issues:

README: {readme_content}

Pinned Issues: {pinned_issues_content}

Title: {issue_title}
Body: {issue_body}

STRICT EVALUATION CRITERIA:
- Is the EXACT same question/issue EXPLICITLY and COMPLETELY addressed?
- Does the README/pinned issues contain SPECIFIC information that DIRECTLY answers this question?
- Is there SUFFICIENT detail to fully resolve the issue?

IMPORTANT: 
- Only mark as COVERED if you are 100% certain the exact issue is EXPLICITLY explained with COMPLETE and SUFFICIENT detail
- DO NOT mark as COVERED for partial matches, similar topics, or general information
- When in doubt, mark as NOT_COVERED

Respond ONLY with:
- `COVERED` - ONLY if 100% certain the exact issue is EXPLICITLY and COMPLETELY covered with sufficient detail
- `NOT_COVERED` - if not explicitly covered, partially covered, or if uncertain
prompts.pr_commit_check:
Analyze this GitHub PR commit title compliance:

Title: {pr_title}

Does this title follow standard Git commit conventions or is it descriptive enough?
Good examples: 'feat: add new feature', 'fix: resolve bug', 'docs: update readme', 'Update README.md', 'Add login functionality', 'Fix authentication issue'
Bad examples: random text, single meaningless words, non-descriptive titles like 'test', 'update', 'fix'

Respond ONLY with:
- `VALID` - if follows conventions or is descriptive
- `INVALID` - if meaningless or completely non-descriptive
prompts.unclear_issue_smart_answer:
Provide a brief, helpful answer for this unclear GitHub Issue based STRICTLY on README content.

README Content: {readme_content}

Issue Title: {issue_title}
Issue Body: {issue_body}

STRICT Requirements:
- ONLY answer if README contains DIRECTLY relevant and EXPLICIT information
- Answer must be based STRICTLY on specific README content, DO NOT fabricate or infer
- DO NOT use general knowledge or assumptions
- Answer must be concise ({smart_answer_length})
- If no EXPLICIT relevant content found in README, respond with NEED_MORE_INFO
- Respond in {answer_language}

Response format:
- If explicit relevant info found in README: HELPFUL_ANSWER: + brief answer in {answer_language} (quote README section)
- If no explicit relevant info in README: NEED_MORE_INFO

responses.issue_spam: 🤖 This issue was detected as spam and will be closed and locked. If you believe this is a mistake, please contact the repository maintainers.
responses.issue_content_filtered: 🤖 The AI provider's content safety policy rejected this issue, so automated checks cannot continue. The issue will be closed but not locked. If you believe this is a mistake, edit the content and submit it again or contact the repository maintainers.
responses.issue_readme_covered: 🤖 Based on the answer above, this question has been resolved and the issue will be closed. Continue the discussion here if you have another question.
responses.issue_basic: 🤖 This issue concerns basic usage. Please check the documentation or use a search engine first.
responses.issue_unclear:
🤖 This issue does not contain enough information. Please add:

- A clear description of the problem
- Expected and actual behavior
- Environment and version information
- Reproduction steps
- Relevant logs or screenshots
responses.pr_closed: 🤖 This pull request was detected as spam or does not meet the commit-title requirements and will be closed. If you believe this is a mistake, please contact the repository maintainers.
responses.pr_content_filtered: 🤖 The AI provider's content safety policy rejected this pull request, so automated checks cannot continue. The pull request will be closed. If you believe this is a mistake, edit the content and submit it again or contact the repository maintainers.
responses.pr_malicious: 🤖 This pull request contains suspicious or malicious content and will be closed. If you believe this is a mistake, please contact the repository maintainers.
responses.pr_trivial: 🤖 This pull request contains trivial or meaningless changes and will be closed. Please ensure the pull request provides a useful improvement.
responses.pr_invalid_commit: 🤖 This pull request title is not descriptive enough or does not follow commit conventions and will be closed. If you believe this is a mistake, please contact the repository maintainers.
